name: UI：F88 新建图文上传策略（全流程）
description: 从策略列表页新建策略，配置 Start 节点入参，添加图文上传节点，保存策略并刷新验证持久化。

steps.description: 验证策略列表页已加载
验证存在新建策略入口

steps.expression: (() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const btn = btns.find(b => b.innerText.trim() === '新建策略' && b.offsetParent !== null); if (btn) { btn.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown', {bubbles:true})); btn.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup', {bubbles:true})); btn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false, btnCount: btns.length }; })()

steps.description: 等待新建策略弹窗加载

steps.expression: (() => { const modals = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); return { modalCount: modals.length, hasModal: modals.length > 0, modalTitle: modals.length > 0 ? modals[0].querySelector('.ant-modal-title')?.textContent : null }; })()

(() => { const input = document.querySelector('input#name'); if (!input) return { ok: false, reason: 'no input' }; const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(input, '自动化测试-图文上传策略'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return { ok: true }; })()

(async () => { const input = document.querySelector('#stageCode'); if (!input) return { ok: false, reason: 'no stageCode input' }; input.focus(); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(input, '视觉'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const options = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-item-option, .ant-select-dropdown .ant-select-item'); for (const opt of options) { if (opt.textContent.trim().includes('视觉')) { opt.click(); return { ok: true, selected: opt.textContent.trim() }; } } return { ok: false, reason: 'option not found', optCount: options.length, opts: Array.from(options).slice(0,5).map(o => o.textContent.trim()) }; })()
steps.description: 选择环节-视觉(通过搜索输入)

steps.expression: (async () => { const input = document.querySelector('#lifeCycleCode'); if (!input) return { ok: false, reason: 'no lifeCycleCode input' }; input.focus(); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(input, '实验'); input.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); const options = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-select-item-option, .ant-select-dropdown .ant-select-item'); for (const opt of options) { if (opt.textContent.trim().includes('实验')) { opt.click(); return { ok: true, selected: opt.textContent.trim() }; } } return { ok: false, reason: 'option not found', optCount: options.length }; })()
steps.description: 选择生命周期-实验(通过搜索输入)
等待生命周期选择生效

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal:not(.ant-modal-hidden)'); if (!modal) return { ok: false }; const btn = [...modal.querySelectorAll('button')].find(b => /确.*定/.test(b.textContent.replace(/\s/g,''))); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { ok: true }; } return { ok: false }; })()
(() => { const url = window.location.href; const match = url.match(/strategy\/detail\/(\d+)/); return match ? { strategyId: match[1], url } : { strategyId: null, url }; })()

steps.description: 验证节点编排区域已渲染
验证 Start 节点存在
点击 Start 节点打开抽屉
等待 Start 抽屉加载
等待字段选择 modal 加载
等待新增节点弹窗加载

steps.expression: (() => { const modals = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-modal'); for (const m of modals) { if (m.classList.contains('ant-modal-hidden')) continue; const r = m.getBoundingClientRect(); if (r.width < 200) continue; const cards = m.querySelectorAll('.ant-card-hoverable, .ant-card'); for (const card of cards) { const t = card.querySelector('.ant-card-meta-title'); if (t && t.textContent.trim() === '图文上传') { card.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' }); card.click(); return { ok: true, nodeName: '图文上传' }; } } } return { ok: false, reason: '图文上传节点未找到' }; })()
steps.description: 点击选择图文上传节点卡片
等待图文上传节点编辑抽屉加载

验证抽屉中显示上传类型字段
验证显示达人账号ID字段
验证显示内容标题字段
